page: Microsoft Azure B2ps_v2 is an entry-level burstable instance within the Bpsv2 virtual machine family, built upon the ARM64 architecture and managed via Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is equipped with 2 physical cores mapped to 2 vCPUs using Ampere ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processors running at a base clock frequency of 3.0 GHz. System memory totals 8.0 GB, yielding 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware cache provisioning features 64 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of shared L3 cache. The platform includes hardware cryptographic support for AES instructions, but lacks vector extensions such as AVX or AMX. The instance contains zero local storage and no dedicated graphics accelerators.

Synthetic benchmarks demonstrate performance typical of a low-core-count burstable profile. In stress-ng evaluations, the single-core score achieves an average tier of 1822.08, while multi-core performance reaches 3597.88. Geekbench scores record 1112.0 for single-core execution and 2025.0 for multi-core throughput, including a software compilation score of 2673.0. In memory benchmarking, cached small-block reads measure 140.71 GB/sec, while uncached large-block reads and writes achieve 26.73 GB/sec and 16.97 GB/sec respectively. Application-level metrics reflect 2.7 million operations per second in Redis SET tests, 2.65 GB/sec throughput in static web serving, and 37.26 tokens per second during small 135M parameter language model text generation.

Because CPU capacity operates under a burstable credit model rather than sustained dedicated compute, performance is susceptible to throttling under continuous computational saturation. The lack of integrated ephemeral storage necessitates external attached volumes for filesystem operations. Consequently, the hardware balance of 4.0 GB per vCPU makes the B2ps_v2 practical for intermittent workloads, including development staging servers, code repositories, low-volume Redis caching, simple background automation, and small microservices that exhibit spiky or idle CPU patterns.
description: Microsoft Azure B2ps_v2 is a burstable general-purpose virtual machine based on the ARM64 architecture. It provides 2 physical cores and 2 vCPUs powered by an Ampere ARMv8 Neoverse-N1 processor operating at 3.0 GHz, paired with 8.0 GB of system memory at a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Cache resources consist of 64 KB L1 data, 1.0 MB L2, and 32 MB L3 cache. The instance includes no local storage and does not feature dedicated GPU acceleration. Benchmark profiles indicate entry-level compute capabilities, registering a Geekbench single-core score of 1112.0 and a multi-core score of 2025.0, alongside moderate compression throughput with gzip reaching 24.19 GB/sec. Uncached large-block read memory bandwidth achieves 26.73 GB/sec, while static web serving reaches 2.65 GB/sec. With its burstable CPU allocation and low resource footprint, the B2ps_v2 provides an economical configuration suited for low-traffic web applications, light microservices, periodic automation tasks, and testing environments.
